name: Neariah
overview: Neariah appears in Scripture as a figure connected to two distinct lineages and roles. He is named among the sons of Shemaiah, with his own descendants listed, highlighting his place within a genealogical record (1 Chronicles 3:22-23). Additionally, Neariah is identified as one of the captains of the Simeonites, leading a contingent of five hundred men, which reflects a position of leadership and responsibility within the tribe of Simeon (1 Chronicles 4:42). These references emphasize Neariah’s significance both as a progenitor and as a military leader in Israel’s history.
